gifts.name: Helia Pendant
gifts.story: Drawn from a single pour of molten gold, then cooled slowly so the metal keeps its quiet weight. The stone was chosen by hand for the way it holds a flame at its centre.

gifts.name: Solene Studs
gifts.story: Born in the heat of the atelier and finished over weeks, not hours. Every facet is angled to catch fire from across a room and hold it.

gifts.name: Étoile Charm
gifts.story: A piece made to outlive the moment it marks — gold that stays, a diamond that never tires of the light, a form pared back to its essence.
